bio.text: Courtney McClain of Spartanburg filed on March 18, 2026 as a Democratic candidate for South Carolina's 4th Congressional District, challenging Republican Rep. William Timmons.

She is president of the South Carolina NAACP's Youth and College Division and graduated from the University of South Carolina in 2023. She interned for former U.S. Rep. Cori Bush through the Congressional Black Caucus Foundation.
She turned 25 in December 2025, the minimum age for a member of Congress.

sources.title: Republican Robert E. Lee and 25-year-old Democrat file to challenge Rep. Timmons in Upstate
